title: Context Layer
summary: Right context at the right time — from the app, not user memory

sections.heading: Orientation
sections.subtitle: Introduction to the Lesson
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **What will you understand?** **How to provide AI with the right context** — **at the right time** — so that **any feature in your product responds to you** **and not** **to anyone else**.
- **Why now?** **Prompt** and **Style** **without Context** = **generic responses**. **The user feels** that the assistant **does not understand them**.
- **What comes after the lesson?** You will write **Context** **for one AI feature** in a product you imagine.

**What comes after the lesson?** You will write **Context** **for one AI feature** in a product you imagine.

sections.heading: Tension
sections.subtitle: Clear Question — Stupid Response
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **"Create a content plan"** — and the response is a **generic copied plan** **not tailored to your project**.
- **The problem is not the question** — **the problem** is that **the AI does not know**: **Who are you?** **For whom?** **How much?** **On which platform?**
- In **any AI application** — **the context you provide** (user profile, stage, last action) = **the difference** between a **"helper"** and a **"wall"**.

sections.heading: Core Idea
sections.subtitle: The Right Context at the Right Time
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **Context** = **all the information** that **the AI sees before responding**: **Who you are**, **what your project is**, **what happened before**.
- **Imagine a doctor with your file** **versus** **a doctor meeting you for the first time**. **Same question** — **different response**.
- In **Builder**: **It is not necessary** for the **user to write the context every time** — **you provide it from the app** (page, role, data).
- **The rule:** **Background before the request**. **The clearer the context** — **the more actionable the output**.

sections.heading: Comparison
sections.subtitle: General Question vs Complete Context
sections.contentMarkdown:
| Without Context | Context Before the Request |
|-----------|----------------|
| **"Create a content plan."** — **the AI guesses**. **Generic plan** — **not tailored to your project** | **"I am a bakery owner in Cairo**, **budget 2000/month**, **target audience women 30–45 on Instagram**. **4-week plan.**" — **a plan you can implement** |

sections.heading: Mission
sections.subtitle: Context for One AI Feature
sections.contentMarkdown:
**Introduction:** **Imagine a product with one AI feature** — **and write the context** that **the app should provide**. **10–15 minutes**.

**Delivery:**

1. **The feature** (example: **"Meal Suggestions"**, **"Support Response"**, **"Report Summary"**)
2. **4 context fields** that the app **provides automatically**:
   - **From the user** (role/type)
   - **From the project/product**
   - **From the session** (last action)
   - **From the stage** (any screen)
3. **Complete Prompt Example** (Context + **Short User Question**)

**Evaluation Criteria:**

| Dimension | Weight | Criteria |
|-------|-------|---------|
| Context from the app | 60% | **4 realistic fields** — **not** that **the user writes them every time**; **the feature is clear** |
| Complete Prompt | 40% | **Context before the question**; **the expected response seems "personalized"** |
